verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an API reference section, with pages on Custom Integration Push APIs / Integration Monitoring and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, so a first-party API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request functionality, code samples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
